title: The privacy notice's list of what Help and feedback sends leaves out the phone's push address and the gym member key
what: Each help message sends the phone's push address (kept with the question so the team's reply can pop up) and, for a gym member, the member's gym key, besides what the privacy notice lists. The notice also says the install number is used only to stop misuse, but the phone uses it to fetch its answers and replies.
expected: The notice names every item a help message carries and every use of the install number, or the phone stops sending what the notice does not name.
fix_line: Add the push address, the gym key and the reply use to the notice's Help and feedback line
